title: Lost Mary Nera15K Orange Bruu Prefilled Vape Pod
description: The Orange Bruu Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod is inspired by a nostalgic orange soda. Sweet, fizzy Orange runs throughout the inhale, while a sparkling soda edge keeps the flavour lively and refreshing. It’s a fun and familiar taste with a playful citrus kick. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together, they deliver up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for coil changes or manual refilling. Equipped with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures smooth vapour production and consistent flavour clarity. Designed for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, setup is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to vape. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
